about_short_description.short_description: Don't die of heart disease. The first AI-native heart health clinic.

product.name: Comprehensive Heart Health
product.description: A direct-to-consumer cardiovascular health program combining a 100+ biomarker lab panel, heart-risk assessment, personalized prevention guidance, and access to the Empirical Health app.

product.name: Empirical Pro
product.description: A premium health-monitoring service in the Empirical Health app that provides biomarker tracking, historical health data, heart-risk scores, and personalized prevention insights.

product.name: Empirical Health Telehealth Services
product.description: Remote clinical consultations provided by independent medical groups through Empirical Health’s platform, including evaluation, treatment recommendations, prescriptions when appropriate, and referrals.

product.name: Empirical Sleep
product.description: A sleep-monitoring app for Apple Watch that assesses sleep and sleep-apnea risk using wearable data and can connect users with clinicians for follow-up care.

product.name: Advanced Heart Health
product.description: A higher-intensity cardiovascular care program listed by Empirical Health that combines advanced heart-risk testing, monitoring, and clinical support.

product.name: Empirical for Business
product.description: An employer-sponsored preventive cardiovascular care program with recurring biomarker testing, personalized health plans, wearable integration, and aggregate workforce reporting.
